acct.lead: Manage shared accounts in one place across online machines with automatic quota failover.
acct.emptyBody: Click "Add account" in the top right to sign in or add a key and share it across all online machines.
acct.tier.missingName: Tier #{place} has no name: enter a name or remove this row
acct.tier.duplicateName: Tier #{second} and #{first} are both named {name}: tier names must be unique
acct.check.hint: Check using an online machine with this executor without making any changes
acct.telemetry.title: Ledger usage telemetry
acct.group.localCredHint: Credentials stay local on each machine to avoid session conflicts; sync tiers, permissions, and concurrency across all {count} machines in one click.
acct.group.tiersSyncHint: Use top-right button to sync all machines
acct.detail.localOnlyHint: Local login available only on this machine; not distributed across hosts.
acct.detail.dshBalanceNote: Supports official / New-API gateway balance queries
acct.detail.liveTokensNote: Tracks per-round token usage in real time
acct.detail.linkedOwnsTitle: Redundant local logins for same account ({count})
acct.detail.linkedOwnsHint: Covered by this shared account and merged here; safe to remove if no longer needed
acct.rail.searchPlaceholder: Search alias, identity, route, or machine…
acct.rail.noMatchesFilter: No accounts match the current filter.
acct.error.nameRequired: Enter a name for this account first
acct.error.duplicateName: An account named {name} already exists. Click Edit on it to make changes.
acct.sheet.editOwnDesc: Local executor login on this machine; used on this machine only.
acct.sheet.editGroupDesc: Saving syncs tiers, permissions, timeout, and concurrency to {machines}; each machine's local OAuth session is unaffected.
acct.sheet.preserveRoutesHint: When checked, only model, reasoning effort, permissions, and concurrency are synced, preserving per-machine routes.
acct.dialog.replaceCredDesc: The old credential is only replaced after the new one is saved; the value is sent once and never displayed again.
acct.dialog.deleteAccountDesc: Tycho will stop storing this login. If queued tasks or active runs depend on it, the service will show the impact and ask you to confirm again.
acct.dialog.deleteOwnDesc: This removes Tycho's saved tiers and limits for this local login without signing out the executor on that machine. You can re-enable it later on the Machines page.
acct.slots.miniPillsTitle: Click to adjust P1 / P2 priority slots in Dispatch policy
acct.slots.defaultAria: Global default dispatch policy by tier
acct.slots.simReasonBalanced: Load-balanced in {slot}: fewest active ({active} runs) and better remaining quota ({quota})
acct.slots.simReasonFallback: P1 unavailable or at capacity, automatically falling back to P2
acct.slots.simReasonNoCandidate: No eligible candidates in P1 or P2 under these conditions; task will wait for capacity.
acct.slots.hintMid: load-balances by fewest active runs then remaining quota; falls back to
acct.slots.hintEnd: when full or cooling down. Distinct routes of the same executor split into independent rows.
acct.add.chooseLead: An account is a login managed by Tycho: sign in once and every machine approved by a project can use it.
acct.add.way.page.title: Authorize on official page
acct.add.way.page.note: Sign in and authorize on its official page; Tycho stores the session for you without touching the CLI or copying tokens.
acct.add.way.page.lead: After authorizing on the official page, Tycho keeps this login for you. Close this window to cancel.
acct.add.way.device.title: Device code sign-in
acct.add.way.device.note: Complete one-time device code authorization with your official subscription (e.g. ChatGPT); Tycho stores and auto-renews it for all approved machines.
acct.add.way.device.lead: Open the verification page in your browser and enter the one-time device code below. Tycho stores and renews it automatically. Close this window to cancel.
acct.add.way.key.title: Enter API key
acct.add.way.key.note: Use a pay-as-you-go API key from the vendor console. Tycho stores it securely for all approved machines.
acct.add.way.key.lead: Enter your API key and tier settings, then save to create the account.
acct.add.way.provider.title: Choose a route & enter key
acct.add.way.provider.note: Connect to an official model service or your own gateway. Tycho stores the key for all approved machines that can reach the endpoint.
acct.add.way.provider.lead: Choose a route, enter your key and tiers, then save to create the account.
acct.add.way.machine.title: Authorize on official page (machine-stored)
acct.add.way.machine.note: Sign in once in your browser with an official subscription (e.g. Google AI Pro / Ultra); credentials stay on the selected machine with auto-renewal, no API key needed.
acct.add.way.machine.lead: Pick an online machine and complete official authorization in your browser; it will renew automatically.
acct.add.executorAccountable: Can be added here — choose a sign-in method below
acct.add.executorMachineOnly: Its login stays on each machine; not stored by Tycho
acct.add.onMachinesPrefix: {executors} do not support centralized credentials yet: to use a local login on a machine, enable it on the
acct.add.hostUnavailable: Not available on this host right now
acct.form.quickRouteHeading: Quick route setup (apply to all tiers, or clear to follow machine default)
acct.form.quickRoutePlaceholder: Enter route name, e.g. deepseek or a custom gateway…
acct.form.effortUnsupportedWarn: This model does not support reasoning effort; clear "{effort}" and leave it blank.
acct.form.effortMismatchWarn: Reasoning effort "{effort}" is not in this model's detected supported list ({supported}) and may be rejected at dispatch.
acct.form.nameHint: You can rename this anytime; projects and tasks keep using the same login.
acct.form.accountScopeNote: This account can run on any online machine with this executor installed, passing the login per round. Projects and tasks can still restrict which machines to use.
acct.form.permModeHint: Leave blank to use this executor's default Worker permission mode.
acct.form.timeoutHint: In minutes. Leave blank to use the default timeout from Settings.
acct.form.maxRunsHint: Leave blank for unlimited. Once reached, new tasks wait until a round finishes, or unpinned tasks switch to another login in the project.
acct.provider.noLines: This executor has no configurable routes
acct.provider.readSuccess: Found {count} models — available in tier dropdowns
acct.provider.readHint: Query this route with the URL and key above; enter models manually for internal endpoints unreachable from the host.
acct.oauth.reloginDone: {signedIn}. The new token is active and will be used for upcoming tasks.
acct.oauth.signedInFillTiers: {signedIn}. Configure tiers and save to create the account.
acct.oauth.autoNameSuffix: ; you can rename it anytime after creation.
acct.oauth.ephemeralTokenNote: The token is held in memory only and not saved yet; closing this window discards it without creating an account.
acct.oauth.reloginDesc: The existing login stays unchanged until the new token is saved; cancelling or failing leaves it intact.
acct.claude.waitingCliReady: Waiting for CLI to accept authorization code…
acct.claude.incognitoHint: Your current browser will use whichever claude.ai account is already signed in. To add a different account, open this URL in an incognito window or another browser.
acct.claude.pasteCodePrompt: Click the button below to authorize in your browser, then paste the code shown on that page here.
acct.claude.codeHint: Each code can only be submitted once.
acct.claude.unknownAccount: Could not identify this Claude account
acct.claude.screenShapeTitle: Redacted screen layout (alphanumerics masked for parser debugging)

acct.codex.devicePrompt: Open the verification page in your browser, sign in to your ChatGPT account, and enter the one-time device code below.
acct.codex.autoRenewNote: This page updates to Signed In automatically once authorized; Tycho stores and renews it centrally for all approved machines.

acct.usage.metricTokensHint: Sum of all four token types: input, output, cache read, and cache write
acct.usage.metricCostHint: List-price API estimate reported by Claude only; subscription accounts are not billed this amount
acct.usage.refreshAllTitle: Refresh all readable logins (uses minimal quota)
acct.usage.lead: Remaining quota per login and token spend across worker rounds and router turns.

acct.usage.mergedAliases: Merged {count} logins on the same subscription
acct.usage.refreshOneTitle: Refresh quota for this login (uses minimal quota)
acct.usage.emptySpendTitle: No usage recorded in this period
acct.usage.emptySpendBody: Usage is recorded from this version onward: one entry per completed worker round, router turn, and quota check.
acct.usage.unpricedChartNote: {count} entries had no price reported (Codex, dsh, and Gemini do not report pricing) and are omitted from this chart.
acct.usage.partialPriceFootnote: * Some entries in this row had no price reported (Codex, dsh, and Gemini do not report pricing); totals reflect priced entries only.
acct.usage.withoutUsageNote: {count} rounds reported no usage (typically interrupted, lost, or executed before usage tracking).

acct.usage.tileDurationDetail: Sum of round durations from start to finish
acct.usage.colUnitsHint: Worker rounds, router turns, and quota checks
acct.usage.colCostHint: List-price API estimate; * indicates some entries were unpriced

acct.comp.partialPriceFootnote: * Some rounds in this row had no price reported (Codex, dsh, Gemini, or unreported usage); cost reflects priced rounds only.
acct.comp.tileReviewedDetail: Rounds with pass or rework verdicts
acct.comp.tileEscalatedDetail: Rejected on review and auto-escalated to a higher tier
